# Overall Project Summary: August 30, 2026

Development on August 30 focused on hardening the ElizaOS cloud infrastructure, specifically improving backup systems, billing consistency, and account management security. Additionally, the team achieved significant stabilization of CI/CD workflows, including the implementation of new staging latency certification processes.

## ✅ Completed Work

**Cloud Infrastructure & Backup Systems**
*   Established a durable foundation for agent backup admission, including schema migrations and GC authority ([elizaos/eliza#29662](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29662)).
*   Implemented repository-level enrollment for backup work by durable shard ([elizaos/eliza#29694](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29694)).
*   Added bounded claimant/recovery authority to prevent shard starvation during backup operations ([elizaos/eliza#29781](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29781)).

**Billing & Account Security**
*   Ensured billing cancellation receipts are preserved during account deletion ([elizaos/eliza#29651](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29651)).
*   Enforced unified account-standing decisions across inference and paid routes to ensure fail-closed security ([elizaos/eliza#29984](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29984), [elizaos/eliza#29977](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29977)).

**CI/CD & Workflow Stability**
*   Restored deterministic contracts for HMR, runtime, and visual/OCR tests ([elizaos/eliza#30071](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30071)).
*   Implemented staging latency certification and improved staging selection re-review operators ([elizaos/eliza#30044](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30044), [elizaos/eliza#30048](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30048)).
*   Refined staging selection bootstrap blockers and neutral reporting ([elizaos/eliza#30100](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30100), [elizaos/eliza#30108](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30108)).
